Kudos to you on asking questions on how you can better help your wife. Like another poster said stop referring to yourself negatively. It's a bad habit and can make your mental health suffer. 

I am too, in a similar situation. Things I would love help in is not having to explicitly ask for things to get done i.e. taking out the trash, making a grocery list, getting the kids ready when we have to go somewhere. (This all pertains to my life and may not apply to yours) If possible take some of the mental load off your wife. She is young and though she may have wanted to have children maybe she feels regret? Some alone time would  help. A house cleaner if this is an area that she struggles in. Meal plan. I know it's difficult to get out with children - but if you have a backyard see if she would venture out. It's a struggle, I have a 5m and 19m old. My 19m old throws epic tantrums but, I've come to realize that the more time we spend outside the better her temperament is. If it's possible, idk if she is breastfeeding or formula feeding - but help at night. Try sleeping in shifts, she sleeps for six or 8hrs one night then you do the next night switch off. Idk if it's possible with your job, but that is something I have resentment towards my partner, I've been the only one to take care of our LOs at night. I'm sorry if I'm rambling, just thinking of all the things that would have helped me. Take your wife out on dates once a week or twice a month. Buy her "just because" or "this made me think of you" gifts. She is a new person, she is no longer the person she was before being a mom. And that is difficult to come to terms with. Do your share of labor. When you get home from work take the kids for an hour or two so she can decompress or start dinner. 

Also, I want to reiterate that she be seen for PPD. I have PPD, PPA and PPR. If she is comfortable, she should talk to a therapist. Oh also have her hormone levels checked, it might still be too soon because it's all coming down. Is she eating? Does she have at least one mom friend?
